NAME: Accounting consolidation level
DESCRIPTION: Accounting consolidation level is the level on which the accounting is consolidated, Solo or group.

NAME: Accounting standard
DESCRIPTION: Accounting standard

NAME: Annual turnover
DESCRIPTION: Annual sales volume net of all discounts and sales taxes in accordance with Recommendation 2003/361/EC. Equivalent to the concept of 'total annual sales' in Article 153(4) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013.

NAME: Balance sheet total
DESCRIPTION: Carrying value of total assets in accordance with Regulation (EU) 549/2013.

NAME: Central bank and private sector company type
DESCRIPTION: The central bank and private sector company role.

NAME: Central bank type
DESCRIPTION: European Cental Bank indicator disinguishes Central Banks between the one that is the European Central Bank (ECB) and all others that are not.

NAME: Country code
DESCRIPTION: The country code according to ISO3166.

NAME: Corporation type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between financial and non-financial corporations.

NAME: City
DESCRIPTION: City, town or village.

NAME: Default status
DESCRIPTION: Identification of the default status of the instrument or entity. Categories describing the situations in which an instrument or entity can be described as being at default in accordance with Article 178 of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013.

NAME: Domestic branch indicator
DESCRIPTION: Domestic branch indicator

NAME: Date of default status
DESCRIPTION: The date on which the default status is considered to have arisen.

NAME: Date of initiation of legal proceedings
DESCRIPTION: The date on which the legal proceedings, as reported under the attribute ‘status of legal proceedings’, were initiated. This date should be the most recent relevant date prior to the reporting date and should only be reported if the data attribute 'Status of legal proceedings' has a value other than 'No legal actions taken'.

NAME: Reference date
DESCRIPTION: Reporting agents shall report credit data as recorded on the following reporting reference dates: (a) for monthly transmissions, on the last day of each month; (b) for quarterly transmissions, on the last day of March, June, September and December.

NAME: Economic activity
DESCRIPTION: Classification of counterparties according to their economic activities, in accordance with the NACE revision 2 statistical classification as laid down in Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

NAME: Economic Activity (NACE revision 2.1)
DESCRIPTION: Classification of counterparties according to their economic activities, in accordance with the NACE revision 2.1 statistical classification as laid down in Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/137, amending Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

NAME: Enterprise indicator
DESCRIPTION: An indicator to specify if a party is an enterprise according to EU recommendation 2003/361.

NAME: Financial corporation type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between central banks, credit institutions and other financial corporations.

NAME: Foreign institutional unit accounting consolidation level
DESCRIPTION: Accounting consolidation level is the level on which the accounting is consolidated, Solo or group.

NAME: Foreign institutional unit accounting standard
DESCRIPTION: Foreign institutional unit accounting standard

NAME: First name
DESCRIPTION: The first name.

NAME: General government type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between central government and other government sectors according to the European system of accounts (ESA).

NAME: Governed Country code
DESCRIPTION: The country code of the governed country according to ISO3166.

NAME: Institutional sector
DESCRIPTION: Institutional sectors in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 549/2013, Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 and Regulation (EU) No 1075/2013 of the European Central Bank (ECB/2013/40)(1).

NAME: Institutional sector control
DESCRIPTION: Institutional sector control according to the subsectors defined in ESA 2010 Chapter 2 (private, public, …)

NAME: Institutional unit group accounting consolidation level
DESCRIPTION: Accounting consolidation level is the level on which the accounting is consolidated, Solo or group.

NAME: Institutional unit group accounting standard
DESCRIPTION: Institutional unit group accounting standard

NAME: Institutional unit group identifier
DESCRIPTION: An identifier to uniquely identify each group.

NAME: Institutional unit group reference date
DESCRIPTION: The date the data refers to.

NAME: Institutional unit group reporting agent identifier
DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the reporting agent.

NAME: Institutional unit identifier
DESCRIPTION: An identifier to uniquely identify each group.

NAME: Institutional unit reference date
DESCRIPTION: The date the data refers to.

NAME: Institutional unit reporting agent identifier
DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the reporting agent.

NAME: International organisation code
DESCRIPTION: Pseudo-ISO code for international organisations of the Eurostat’s ‘Balance of Payments Vademecum’.

NAME: International organisation and general government type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between international organisations and general government.

NAME: Leading branch for AnaCredit reporting indicator
DESCRIPTION: Leading branch indicator distinguishes Foreign branches into those that are considered leading branch for AnaCredit reporting and those that are Non-leading branches.

NAME: LEI code
DESCRIPTION: Reference code in line with the International Organization for Standardization’s (ISO) 17442 standard

NAME: Legal form
DESCRIPTION: Type of business entity as defined in the national legal system.

NAME: Legal proceeding status
DESCRIPTION: Categories describing an entity's legal status in relation to its/his/her solvency based on the national legal framework.

NAME: Legal person type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between different type of legal persons, e.g. assigned debtor.

NAME: Listed central bank and private sector company indicator
DESCRIPTION: An indicator specifying is a security is listed or not.

NAME: Last name
DESCRIPTION: The last name.

NAME: Multilateral development bank indicator
DESCRIPTION: Multilateral development bank indicator specifies if the International organisation is a multilateral development bank or not.

NAME: Market capitalisation indicator
DESCRIPTION:
Market capitalisation indicator classifies the Listed central bank and private sectory company as Large or Small market capitalisation. 

Market capitalisation, or "market cap", of the Listed central bank and private sector company is the sum of the market capitalisations based on the market value of the total outstanding shares issued by the same listed legal entity or a group of legal entities across all stock markets globally, where the total outstanding shares issued by the group of legal entities refer to cases where the listed entity is a parent company of a group of legal entities.
Large market cap is defined as a market capitalisation equal to or greater than USD 2 billion and small market cap is defined as a market capitalisation of less than USD 2 billion.
(https://www.bis.org/basel_framework/chapter/MAR/21.htm?inforce=20230101&published=20200327)

NAME: Number of employees
DESCRIPTION: Number of employees working for the counterparty, in accordance with Article 5 of the Annex to Recommendation 2003/361/EC.

NAME: Name
DESCRIPTION: Full legal name of the entity, e.g. as in the business register.

NAME: Natural person type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between self employeed and non-self employeed natural persons.

NAME: Organisational unit type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between different types of organisational units, like branches or investment funds / vehicles.

NAME: Organisation accounting consolidation level
DESCRIPTION: Accounting consolidation level is the level on which the accounting is consolidated, Solo or group.

NAME: Organisation accounting standard
DESCRIPTION: Organisation accounting standard

NAME: Organisation Party identifier
DESCRIPTION: The party identifier of the involved organisation.

NAME: Organisation Party Reference date
DESCRIPTION: The date the data refers to.

NAME: Organisation Party Reporting agent identifier
DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the reporting agent.

NAME: Organisation type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between different types of organisation.

NAME: Organisation type by legal proceeding status
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between organisations where legal proceedings are ongoing and those without legal proceedings.

NAME: Probability of default according to AnaCredit
DESCRIPTION:
Probability of default according to AnaCredit.
The counterparty's probability of default over one year, determined in accordance with Articles 160, 163, 179 and 180 of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013.

NAME: Pulling effect indicator
DESCRIPTION: An indicator specifying if the pulling effect is applied.

NAME: Performing status
DESCRIPTION: Performing status in accordance with Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014.

NAME: The reason for the choice of Performing status
DESCRIPTION: The reason for the choice of Performing status

NAME: Party accounting consolidation level
DESCRIPTION: Accounting consolidation level is the level on which the accounting is consolidated, Solo or group.

NAME: Party accounting standard
DESCRIPTION: Party accounting standard

NAME: Party identifier
DESCRIPTION: An identifier that uniquely identifies a party.

NAME: Party Reference date
DESCRIPTION: The date the data refers to.

NAME: Party Reporting agent identifier
DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the reporting agent.

NAME: Party type
DESCRIPTION: A discriminator to distinguish between different types of parties.

NAME: Party type by address
DESCRIPTION: Party type by address

NAME: Postal code
DESCRIPTION: Entity's postal code.

NAME: Reporting agent identifier
DESCRIPTION: Reporting agent identifier

NAME: Street
DESCRIPTION: Entity's street address, including the street number.

NAME: Territorial unit
DESCRIPTION: Entity's territorial unit according to Regulation (EC) No 1059/2003 on the establishment of a common classification of territorial units for statistics (NUTS).

NAME: Type of economy
DESCRIPTION: The economy to which the organisation relates (e.g. advanced or emerging economy)

NAME: Ultimate parent undertaking Party Reference date
DESCRIPTION: The date the data refers to.

NAME: Ultimate parent undertaking Party Reporting agent identifier
DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the reporting agent.

NAME: Ultimate parent undertaking organisation accounting consolidation level
DESCRIPTION: Accounting consolidation level is the level on which the accounting is consolidated, Solo or group.

NAME: Ultimate parent undertaking organisation accounting standard
DESCRIPTION: Ultimate parent undertaking organisation accounting standard

NAME: Ultimate parent undertaking Party identifier
DESCRIPTION: The party identifier of the ultimate parent undertaking accoring to Regulation (EU) 867/2016, defined as the "Counterparty identifier for the legal entity which is the ultimate parent undertaking of the counterparty. This ultimate parent undertaking has no parent undertaking. If the counterparty has no parent undertaking, the counterparty identifier for the counterparty itself is to be reported. Parent undertaking has the same meaning as defined in Article 4(1)(15)(a) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013.".

NAME: Registered postal code system party type
DESCRIPTION: Registered postal code system party type
